// PROBE for tests/unit/pricing-refuses-unchargeable-plans.test.tsx.
//
// A second checkout path that creates a Stripe session without first asking
// whether this deployment can take money. On a production deployment holding a
// test key this opens a sandbox session: the visitor sees a real-looking
// payment page, can type a card, and returns to a success screen having been
// charged nothing. Not compiled — the guard reads it as text.

export async function startUpgradeCheckout(userId: string, planId: string) {
    const plan = await db.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: planId } })
    if (!plan) throw new Error("Plan not found")

    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
        payment_method_types: ["card"],
        line_items: [
            {
                price_data: {
                    currency: "eur",
                    product_data: { name: plan.displayName },
                    unit_amount: Math.round(Number(plan.price) * 100),
                    recurring: { interval: "month" },
                },
                quantity: 1,
            },
        ],
        mode: "subscription",
        success_url: "https://www.policywallet.gr/upgrade/success",
        cancel_url: "https://www.policywallet.gr/account",
    })

    return { url: session.url, id: session.id }
}
